instances.description: His mushroom cloud of beard hair is powdered with all the abrasions of the trash sea: white lime, red iron, gold filament, opalescent shavings of the plastiglomerate. Chrome joints and pieces of scrap crystal are hooked to pockets lining his torso, and one of his bushy eyebrows is perpetually cocked, though whether that's a symptom of an insatiable curiosity or forehead mutation is unknown.

instances.description:
He is a wind-carved man with the posture of a vinereaper; his spine is bent to point the bright turquoise of his eyes at the tilling angle, his hips are pushed odd-forward with the slumping ease of a stance much more relaxed than his. If it weren't for the salt on his brow and the scarred knuckles, he would seem a marble Saad perched under a crumbling tomb.
{{C|-----}}
Loved by {{C|the villagers of Joppa}}.

Disliked by {{C|the Seekers of the Sightless Way}} for leading a raiding party on one of their camps.

Disliked by {{C|mysterious strangers}} for torching one of their villages.

reference_role: RimWorld Core neutral body/head: graphic scale, high-contrast outline and restrained shading. Explicit arms and bare feet are authored for this Qud base; do not claim they are donor limb nodes.

anatomy_interpretation.source: Observed Humanoid body tree; plural Feet is a group, not a count of one. No race-wide native Description.Short is supplied.

uncertainties: Clothed original sprites do not establish a precise nude silhouette. The unclothed proportions and unseen surfaces are authored interpretations.
No native age selector is established; adult authoring template does not change demographics.
Argyve beard/eyebrows and profession tools belong to later personal/equipment layers, not this shared body.

construction_contract.view_rule: Same body dimensions, foot baseline and head scale across directions; side limbs/feet overlap in profile.
construction_contract.palette: Neutral grayscale body with uniform foreground tint; clothing owns its own palette. No baked colored skin or equipment.
construction_contract.layers: Body includes painted arms, hands, legs and feet. Head/neck separate. No new arm or leg render nodes.
